title: Target Hands Passing
description: Receivers hold their hands up as a target in different spots; passers must hit the target exactly with a chest, bounce or overhead pass.

content.objective: Deliver accurate passes to the receiver's target hands, choosing the right pass type for where the target is.
content.setup: Partners face each other four metres apart with one ball.
content.organization: Pairs; the receiver changes the target after every catch.
instructions: The receiver shows two hands at chest height: the passer throws a chest pass.
The receiver shows hands at the hip: the passer throws a bounce pass that arrives at the hip.
The receiver shows hands above the head: the passer throws an overhead pass.
The receiver mixes the targets at random.
coachingPoints: Step toward the target as you pass.
Follow through with thumbs down and fingers pointing at the target.
Bounce passes hit the floor about two-thirds of the way to the receiver.
commonMistakes: Passing without stepping, so the ball floats.
Bounce pass landing too close to the passer.
Ignoring the target and passing to the chest every time.
content.safety: Pairs face the same direction as the next pair so loose balls do not fly into other players.
progressions: Receiver moves the target while the ball is in the air.
Add a passive defender between partners.
variations: One-hand push passes to the target.
Count perfect hits out of ten.
successCriteria: 8 of 10 passes arrive in the target hands.
Correct pass type for every target.
content.gameApplication: Receivers show where they want the ball; passers who hit that target let shooters shoot and cutters finish without adjusting.
